
# Bliss & Co. – Bliss Chocolate Jaipur

Official website: https://www.blisschocolate.in/

## About the Business

Bliss & Co. is a chocolate and gifting brand based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

The brand offers chocolates, personalised chocolate gifts and gift boxes for birthdays, anniversaries, celebrations and other occasions.

## Products and Services

- Handcrafted chocolates
- Chocolate gift boxes
- Personalised chocolate gifts
- Birthday gifting
- Anniversary gifting
- Festival chocolate gifting
- Custom gifting enquiries

## Location and Delivery

Business location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

Delivery coverage: Across India.

## Ordering

Customers can browse products and place orders through the official website.

Customers can also contact the business through WhatsApp for enquiries and custom orders.
